description: This file contains the PHP class 'Manufacturer' within the Opencart\

classes.name: Manufacturer
classes.description: Represents the Manufacturer model for CRUD operations and retrieving manufacturer data in OpenCart.

methods.name: getManufacturer
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific manufacturer by its ID, ensuring it belongs to the current store.

methods.name: getManufacturers
methods.description: Fetches a list of manufacturers, supporting sorting, ordering, and pagination, with caching.

methods.name: getLayoutId
methods.description: Gets the layout ID associated with a specific manufacturer, if available.
